messages:
nina_fin: FYI spotted an odd pattern: preemptible pools racked up $5.6k yesterday but were attributed to three different customer projects. suspect tagging noise from CI runners.

jon_finops: that could mess with our monthly allocation. do we have query results?

ravi_cloudops: quick dump attached — most of the cost mapped to projects with `ci-runner` tag missing. stacktrace shows onboarding hook set tag inference priority wrong.

cost_alert_bot: ALERT: gpu_daily_spike detected for project: customer-omega (value: $1,900) severity: medium :warning:

platform_idp: cc @ravi_cloudops i rolled out the new inference to reduce manual onboarding. seems like shared CI keys mean some jobs inherit wrong project metadata.

nina_fin: Action plan: 1) generate two allocations (explicit tags only + inferred) for last 30 days, 2) mark low-confidence rows as "unassigned", 3) propose customer credits if mis-bill > $2k.

jon_finops: please include a column for `inference_method` and `confidence`. Finance will run reconciliation and draft credit notes.

ravi_cloudops: will run BigQuery backfill tonight. SQL snippet: SELECT project_id, inference_method, inference_confidence, SUM(gpu_cost) as cost FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_usage.gpu_daily` WHERE usage_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE() GROUP BY project_id, inference_method, inference_confidence;

platform_idp: I'll feature-flag a rollback to the previous inference order and canary it on 5 hosts. Also adding monitoring to detect >20% month-over-month allocation variance per project.

nina_fin: timeline? we need provisional numbers before invoice finalization in 4 days.

ravi_cloudops: backfill by tomorrow EOD. rollback flag ready, canary within 24hrs after that if needed.

jon_finops: ok schedule 9am PT sync tomorrow to review provisional allocation and decide on credits. Thanks.

cost_alert_bot: NOTE: created ticket BILL-4412 for preemptible allocation reconciliation.
